body.statement: Whenever every \(\rho\in\Omega(\mathcal P;Y,X,C)\) fails its terminal sIDP call, does the handle \(H_{\mathrm{lock}}(\mathcal P;Y,X,C,\Omega)\) produce a represented residual forest and a rational interior one- or two-mechanism observational-fiber tangent satisfying \(E_Tq=0\) and \(b_Tq\neq0\), or another explicit positive rational construction with the same full selected observational law and the same positive terminal denominator but a different terminal numerator? Can such an object be streamed in \(O(3^n\operatorname{poly}(n)+L_{\Gamma})\) bit operations?
body.justification: This is the exact missing bridge from graphical failure to a reusable nonidentification certificate; neither ordinary hedge disagreement nor semantic nonidentifiability supplies the denominator lock automatically.
body.gap: Chen--Mooij's residual-forest converse is unconditional, while no checked conditional-PAG or selected-hedge result coordinates all reachable role states and an informative selected denominator.
body.consumer: A positive answer upgrades Branch-sCIDP from a sound formula search to a formula-or-checkable-failure decision procedure for selected-cohort PAG analysis.
